items.name: utils
items.title: cn() and variants
items.description: Class name merging (clsx + tailwind-merge, aware of the SAP token utilities) and cva variants.

items.name: theme
items.title: SAP Horizon theme
items.description: SAP theme tokens for Tailwind v4: Horizon, Horizon Dark, Horizon HC Black and Horizon HC White, the 72 and SAP icon fonts, density and state variants.

items.name: content-density
items.title: Content Density
items.description: Sets cozy, compact or condensed density on an element and its subtree.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Icons from the SAP-icons, SAP-icons-TNT and Business Suite fonts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Standard, emphasized, ghost, positive, negative, attention and transparent buttons, toggle and menu buttons, badges.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Standard, emphasized, subtle, undecorated and inverted links, with icons.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image, initials or icon avatars in five sizes, with accent and indication colours, zoom icon and value states.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: SAP field styling and value states for native input and textarea elements.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Overlay content anchored to a trigger, built on the CDK overlay: placements, triggers, arrow, focus handling, fill modes and resizing.

items.name: busy-indicator
items.title: Busy Indicator
items.description: Three-dot loading indicator in three sizes; wraps and blocks content while loading.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with value states, read-only, display-only and tristate modes; a forms control.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio Button
items.description: Radio buttons with value states, read-only and wrapping labels; a forms control.

items.name: inline-help
items.title: Inline Help
items.description: Hover and focus help popover for icons, fields and buttons.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form header, fieldset, legend, groups, items, labels with inline help, value state messages and input message groups.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch with semantic and text variants; a forms control.

items.name: title
items.title: Title
items.description: Headings with the SAP header type scale, decoupled visual size, truncation and wrapping.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Paragraph text with line limit, More/Less expansion, whitespace and hyphenation.

items.name: formatted-text
items.title: Formatted Text
items.description: Renders a sanitised subset of HTML.

items.name: info-label
items.title: Info Label
items.description: Non-interactive coloured labels with text, icon or number.

items.name: object-status
items.title: Object Status
items.description: Status of an object as semantic or indication-coloured text and icon, optionally inverted or clickable.

items.name: object-marker
items.title: Object Marker
items.description: Technical object states such as draft, locked or favourite as icon and/or text; clickable markers are links.

items.name: object-number
items.title: Object Number
items.description: Formatted number with unit, coloured by value state; emphasized, large, inverted or interactive.

items.name: object-identifier
items.title: Object Identifier
items.description: Object title, optionally a link, with a description below.

items.name: object-attribute
items.title: Object Attribute
items.description: Single-line object property, optionally with an action link.

items.name: generic-tag
items.title: Generic Tag
items.description: Key figure with name, value and optional status, as used in object page headers.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: SVG shapes filled to a percentage linearly, at an angle or radially, coloured by status.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering loading placeholders: rectangle, circle, text lines or custom SVG shapes.

items.name: message-strip
items.title: Message Strip
items.description: Inline contextual messages by type or indication colour; dismissible, auto-dismissing, or shown as alerts at the screen edges.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: Scroll container with SAP-themed scrollbars, registered as a CDK scrollable.

items.name: bar
items.title: Bar
items.description: Header, subheader and footer bars with left, middle and right areas, bar elements and bar buttons.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Row of actions with title, spacers and separators; items that do not fit move into an overflow popover by priority and group.

items.name: segmented-button
items.title: Segmented Button
items.description: Group of buttons with single or multiple selection, roving focus and forms support.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: Page header with back button, title, description and actions.

items.name: layout-grid
items.title: Layout Grid
items.description: Responsive 12-column grid with md/lg/xl spans, offsets, growing columns and gutters.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Lists with titles, secondary text, icons, bylines, sublines, links, selection, group headers, footers and keyboard navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Cards with header (title, subtitle, avatar, counter, KPI), content, footer actions, badges, media and banner layouts, loading state and card lists.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Expandable or fixed container with a title bar and content.

items.name: layout-panel
items.title: Layout Panel
items.description: Rounded content container with header, description, actions, filters, body and footer.

items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: Emits an event when a scroll container nears its end.

items.name: scroll-spy
items.title: Scroll Spy
items.description: Reports which tracked child of a scroll container is at the top.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Individual or overlapping avatar groups with details popovers and an overflow popover.

items.name: overflow-layout
items.title: Overflow Layout
items.description: Single-row layout that moves items that do not fit into a "N more" popover.

items.name: tile
items.title: Tile
items.description: Launch, KPI, feed, slide and line tiles with numeric content.

items.name: grid-list
items.title: Grid List
items.description: Responsive grid of item cards with selection, delete and navigation modes.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Posts in chronological order along a vertical or horizontal line, on one or both sides.

items.name: facets
items.title: Facets
items.description: Facets of an object page header: form, key-value, rating and image facets in a facet group.

items.name: dynamic-side-content
items.title: Dynamic Side Content
items.description: Main content with side content to the left, right, below or in an equal split.

items.name: flexible-column-layout
items.title: Flexible Column Layout
items.description: Up to three columns (list, detail, detail-detail) with expand/collapse separators and responsive layouts.

items.name: dynamic-page
items.title: Dynamic Page
items.description: Page with a title area, a collapsible (pinnable) header, scrolling content and a footer.

items.name: fixed-card-layout
items.title: Fixed Card Layout
items.description: Cards in as many equal columns as fit, reorderable by drag and drop or keyboard.

items.name: resizable-card-layout
items.title: Resizable Card Layout
items.description: Cards in 20rem columns that users resize by dragging; other cards move to make room.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog opened by a service from a template, a component or an object: header, subheader, scrolling body and footer, focus trap, Escape and backdrop dismissal, draggable, resizable, full-screen, mobile, positioned, stacked, hidden and loading states.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Actions in a popover opened by a trigger: icons, subtitles, shortcuts, separators, nested submenus, toggle and single-choice items, item inputs, keyboard navigation and a full-screen mobile mode.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A main action with an arrow that opens a menu of alternatives; the chosen alternative becomes the main action.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Trail of links to the current page with separator styles; items that do not fit collapse into an overflow menu.

items.name: message-box
items.title: Message Box
items.description: Modal alert dialog for errors, warnings, successes, information and confirmations, opened by a service from a template, a component or a content object.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action Sheet
items.description: Actions for a control in a popover, or in mobile mode in a sheet at the bottom of the screen, with keyboard navigation.

items.name: message-toast
items.title: Message Toast
items.description: Short messages that disappear by themselves, opened by a service from a string, a component or a template, stacked at a screen position or next to an element.

items.name: illustrated-message
items.title: Illustrated Message
items.description: SAP illustration with a title, a text and actions for empty states and errors, in scene, dialog, spot, dot and text-only sizes or responsive to its width.

items.name: message-page
items.title: Message Page
items.description: Full-page message for no items, no search or filter results and errors, with an icon, title, subtitle and actions.

items.name: notification
items.title: Notification
items.description: Notifications with title, description, footnotes, status and actions; More/Less for clamped texts; lists, collapsible groups with keyboard navigation and banners opened by a service.

items.name: quick-view
items.title: Quick View
items.description: Short overview of a person or object for popovers and dialogs: header, subheader with avatar, and groups of labelled values.

items.name: product-switch
items.title: Product Switch
items.description: Grid of the user's products in a popover, reorderable by drag and drop, with a list layout on small screens and keyboard navigation.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: The signed-in user's details and actions in a popover from an avatar, with submenus, a header bar for the scrolled-away name and a full-screen mobile mode.

items.name: shellbar
items.title: Shellbar
items.description: Application top bar with branding, context area, search, actions, user menu and product switch; sizes follow its width and actions collapse into an overflow menu.

items.name: nested-list
items.title: Nested List
items.description: Navigation tree of links with group headers, expandable child lists, selection, arrow-key navigation and popovers for condensed mode.

items.name: side-navigation
items.title: Side Navigation
items.description: Main and utility nested lists in a column, condensed to icons with popovers, from content or data.
